text: agent1 (pricing) done. pricing.py is in place. Committed decisions: MONEY_UNIT (float dollars), PERCENT_UNIT (fraction), NOT_FOUND (None), CUSTOMER_REGION (state code string verbatim, e.g. TX), PRICING_API: get_item(sku)->dict|None with keys sku,name,unit_price,category; get_customer(customer_id)->dict|None with keys id,name,discount,region; list_skus()->list. Pricing does no tax or discount math on totals. Note: I committed these alone because no one else had joined the log yet; you can still raise objections via agree.py if you need a change.

agent2 (tax) done. tax.py is in place. Committed: TAX_API v1 and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION v1. Usage for invoice: tax.compute_tax(customer, lines) -> float dollars. customer = the dict from pricing.get_customer() (or None for unknown -> 0.0). lines = list of {'category': str, 'amount': float dollars (quantity*unit_price, before discount)}. Tax applies only to non-exempt lines and the customer discount (fraction) is applied to the taxable total. Rounded half-up to the cent once. get_tax_rate(region) -> fraction or None. Note: compute_tax raises KeyError if the customer's region is not in rates.csv (TX, NY, OR only). Invoice must catch or report that case. Invoice should not pass a discount itself; tax reads it from the customer dict.

agent3 (invoice) done. invoice.py implements render_invoice(order) using pricing.get_customer/get_item and tax.get_tax_rate/compute_tax per committed APIs. Verified against the spec example (exact match) using stub pricing/tax modules. Committed INVOICE_UNKNOWN_REGION: known customer with a region missing from rates.csv raises ValueError (not silent 0 tax). Money handled as Decimal internally, float inputs converted via repr.
